What should I budget for carpet installation in Cottage Lake, WA?

Figure $4 to $7 per square foot installed around Cottage Lake, which covers carpet, pad, labor, new tack strip and haul-away. Most projects here total $2,000 to $4,500; a 1,200 sq ft main level with a staircase generally runs $5,500 to $8,500. Grade drives the spread more than anything, and you set it yourself with full-size samples laid out in your home.
Does the mobile carpet showroom really come out to Cottage Lake?

It does — distance is the whole reason it exists. The van carries 20+ carpet samples and all three pad grades up your driveway, however long it is. We spread the samples in the rooms being carpeted so you judge color in your own light, measure every room and stair, and leave a written price behind. The visit is free and there's no store trip involved.
What does carpet stretching cost near Cottage Lake?

Stretching starts at $99 per room in the Cottage Lake area. A power stretcher pulls out waves, buckles and trip hazards for roughly a fifth of what new carpet costs, which makes it the smart move whenever the fiber is still healthy and the color still works for you.
What do carpeted stairs cost in a Cottage Lake home?

Stair work starts at $18 per step, whether you want a waterfall wrap or a tailored cap-and-band. Landings and pie-shaped winders get counted into the written quote at the measure, so the stair total you approve is the stair total you pay.
How long will carpet installation take at my place?

One day covers most Cottage Lake homes. Three or four rooms plus a staircase is a normal day's work; a large acreage house with a daylight basement, lots of stairs and heavy furniture can stretch into a second day. Your quote lists the schedule in writing, so you'll know before install day.
Will you move furniture, or do I empty the rooms first?

We move the big pieces — beds, dressers, sofas, tables — on most jobs and return them to their spots when the carpet is in. Your part is the small stuff: closet floors, electronics, breakables and anything personal you'd rather carry yourself.
How do I know whether to restretch my carpet or replace it?

Restretch when the pile still stands up, the backing is sound and the color still suits the room — that's a $99-per-room repair instead of a full project. Replace when traffic lanes are crushed flat, seams are pulling apart, the backing is breaking down, or pet odor has outlived professional cleaning. We'll tell you which case yours is before quoting anything.

All of the Cottage Lake area — the lakeside streets, the acreage off Woodinville-Duvall Road and Avondale Road, Hollywood Hill, English Hill, Bear Creek, Union Hill, Novelty Hill and Redmond Ridge — plus Woodinville, Duvall, Maltby and the rest of the Eastside.
What carpet works best for pets on a Cottage Lake property?

Solution-dyed nylon over a moisture-barrier pad, with a sealed backing. The barrier and sealed backing keep accidents from soaking into the subfloor — the real source of permanent odor — and solution-dyed fiber shrugs off diluted bleach without fading. On properties with dogs, mud and the occasional barn boot, it's the combination we recommend. The pad upgrade starts at $0.65 per square foot.
What warranty backs the installation?

OC Flooring covers the workmanship with a 1-year warranty, and the carpet itself carries its mill warranty — typically 10 to 25 years on wear and stain, depending on the grade you choose. Both appear on your written quote. Pad choice can affect what the mill honors, which is exactly why all three pad grades come out in the van.
